title: onychium chaerophyllum
intro: Onychium chaerophyllum, commonly known as Onychium, is a type of flowering plant in the asparagus family (Asparagaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting expectoration. The therapeutic actions of Onychium include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving respiratory tract irritations and promoting the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Onychium include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
